equation_summary: Each sequence is split into chunks; the last chunk per sample is excluded from the target pool (causality). Gate score for a candidate block = q . mean_pool(k_block) (fp32 einsum 'nhk,thk->nht'); blocks ending before the query or past sample end are masked -inf; top-(topk-1) blocks are selected per (head, token), with the current block always served by chunk-local self-attention. Selected-block attention and local self-attention are merged via an online-softmax LSE combine, equal to a single softmax over the union of attended keys.
state_shape: external KV cache; block-mean gate weights derived externally
gate_scope: data-dependent block route scores (mean-pooled key dot query)
normalization: softmax with LSE merge over local ∪ selected blocks
